Title: Azure HDInsight is now available in the UAE North region

Body.Content:
Azure HDInsight is now available in the UAE North region.

Azure HDInsight is a fully managed cloud service that makes it easy, fast, and cost-effective to process massive amounts of data. Use the most popular open-source frameworks, such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Interactive Query (LLAP), Kafka, Storm, HBase, and Microsoft R Server. 

For more information about HDInsight,see the Azure HDInsight documentation.
